subject.title: Expose maxMissedJobsPerRestart and missedJobStaggerMs in cron config

question: Should OpenClaw expose public cron restart catch-up controls for max immediate missed jobs and missed-job staggering, or keep those as internal safeguards while fixing duplicate catch-up behavior through narrower scheduler rules?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but AGENTS.md and VISION.md make new config/default surfaces compatibility-sensitive, and related open issues cover narrower missed-run and duplicate-run behaviors.

options.title: Expose Narrow Public Controls
options.body: Add documented global cron restart catch-up controls with validation, Gateway wiring, and fresh-install plus upgrade proof while preserving current defaults.

options.title: Keep Internals Private
options.body: Leave the internal safeguards as implementation details and close or supersede this only after narrower scheduler fixes resolve duplicate user-facing deliveries.

options.title: Defer For Cron Policy Design
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical design thread until maintainers settle global versus per-job catch-up semantics.

recommendation.title: Expose Narrow Public Controls
recommendation.body: Add documented global cron restart catch-up controls with validation, Gateway wiring, and fresh-install plus upgrade proof while preserving current defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent cron/config work and product-surface changes make this the best available routing candidate from the observed history.
